name: Diagnostic Scan
desc: SCAN SUPPORT: scans every foe, exposing weak points (-35% DEF) and feeding the squad targeting data (+20% Crit). Never misses.

name: Nevermore Heart
desc: She never raises her voice. She doesn't have to -- the hood comes down, the four words leave her mouth flat and quiet (azarath, metrion, zinthos), and her whole soul-self peels away from her body as a black raven the size of the battlefield, wings blotting out everything. It should be terrifying. It would be, if it weren't also stitched with little pink hearts along the trailing edge of every feather, the same cloying pastel plush pink from a stuffed bear's ribbon -- brooding darkness wearing something disarmingly soft over it, and never quite explaining why. Whatever it swallows doesn't come back out clean.

statusEffects.label: IT'S NOT SUPPOSED TO BE CUTE

name: Heart Radiance
desc: Royal love: a team heal that also cleanses all debuffs and empowers every ally's ATK.

name: Relic Song
desc: A legendary melody that buffs the squad's ATK and DEF and surges 30 Burst to everyone.

name: Polka-Dot Dazzle
desc: A dazzling cheer that buffs ATK, shields, and regenerates the whole team.

name: Frost Aegis
desc: Ice-magic protection that cleanses, shields, and heals the entire party over time.

name: Triforce of Wisdom
desc: Sacred wisdom: cleanses allies and wards them, while stripping every enemy of their buffs.

name: Hazbin Redemption
desc: Radiant hope: heals and cleanses the squad, then inspires lasting ATK and Regen.
flavor: Hell is forever, but so is hope!

name: Act of True Love
desc: A selfless act that heals, cleanses, shields, and steadies the whole squad.
flavor: Some people are worth melting for.

name: Pacify Aura
desc: A warm aura that heals, cleanses, shields, and gently builds the team's Burst.
flavor: I hope we can be friends!

name: Tidal Refrain
desc: A refreshing splash that heals, cleanses, and quickens the whole squad — raising SPD AND flooding everyone with HASTE so their skills charge noticeably faster.

name: Gotta Go Fast
desc: SPIN DASH: Sonic revs up for a bit of HASTE and +SPD. Fast, flashy, and just not that useful in a real fight -- he still doesn't hit anyone. Every basic attack that connects now also nudges his own skill bar forward.

name: Gale Larceny
desc: WIND THIEF: a blink-quick strike that steals a buff from the foe and rides the tailwind — Mia gains +SPD and HASTE, so her next skill comes back up far sooner. Cannot be dodged.

name: Jewel Heist
desc: TREASURE HUNTER: a sure critical that snatches a buff off the target and drains 20% of the damage as health.

name: Soft Paws, Sharp Claws
desc: A flawless cat-burglar strike: steals a buff, always crits, and slips past 30% of armor.
flavor: Did you really think you could catch me?

name: Hookshot Ambush
desc: A grappling ambush that steals a buff, then repositions Ada with +SPD, HASTE (her next skill recharges much faster), and a shield. Always connects.

name: Flare Detonation
desc: Ignites all foes, then instantly DETONATES every burn/poison/static on them for 140% of its remaining damage.

name: Blue Sky Catalyst
desc: A volatile reaction that poisons all foes and detonates their damage-over-time stacks for a chemical blast.
flavor: I am the one who knocks.

name: Radio Demon's Symphony
desc: Static fire engulfs all foes; consumes every DoT on them as a burst, healing Alastor for 30% of all damage.

name: Hyakuretsukyaku
desc: Lightning Legs slow the foe, then strike a guaranteed crit that deals +60% to slowed enemies.

name: Agidyne Bloom
desc: Sets every foe ablaze, then deals +50% damage to anything burning. Self-igniting inferno.

name: Myriad Truths
desc: Zio cascades shock all foes; deals +50% to anything shorted out and shatters shields.

name: Flash Freeze
desc: An icy cyclone that freezes, then shatters: +60% damage to frozen foes, healing Ellen.

name: Absolute Zero
desc: Eternal winter freezes and slows everything, then strikes frozen foes for +50%.
flavor: The cold never bothered me anyway.

name: Mystic Fire Wand
desc: Mystic flame burns all foes and intensifies (+45%) against anything already burning.

name: Just Like You
desc: Phoebe smiles, and for a second the squad's own guard drops, because the smile is right, the warmth is right, everything about her reads as another exhausted party of survivors who just wants to stick together. That's the trick a Partygoer's always played -- perfectly humanoid, perfectly warm, perfectly wrong. She lifts whatever the target was hiding behind for herself, singles them out from the crowd so there's nowhere left to blend into, and then, only once they've relaxed around her, the smile goes a little too wide and stops looking human at all. Whatever they felt safe holding onto a second ago, they don't anymore.
flavor: It's okay. I'm just like you.

name: Bad Time
desc: Karmic Retribution pierces 60% DEF and applies stacking decay; deals DOUBLE damage to foes below 40% HP.
flavor: you're gonna have a bad time.

name: Star Platinum: ORA Barrage
desc: A time-stopped flurry of guaranteed crits; finishes foes below 45% HP for nearly double, with heavy stagger.

name: Voidhunter's Verdict
desc: A Hollow-hunting strike: always crits, pierces 40% armor, and executes wounded prey below 40% HP.

name: Red Soul Slash
desc: A determined blade, guided by the soul, that lands a sure crit and finishes foes below 35% HP.

name: Precision Headshot
desc: A trained headshot: ignores 50% DEF, always crits, and executes anything below 40% HP outright.

name: Slots: Triple Seven
desc: Three reels, three real outcomes: a BUST still crits the field and shields Cait Sith, a PAIR hits harder and pumps the squad's attack, and the rare JACKPOT (all three reels match) unleashes a massive elemental/crit surge for the whole team AND deletes anything already below half HP. Genuinely luck-of-the-draw -- scales with Luck.

name: Malevolent Shrine
desc: A domain of endless slashes: ignores 50% DEF, applies Dismantle, and cleaves the wounded (below 40% HP).

name: Viltrumite Onslaught
desc: An unstoppable haymaker that ignores half of DEF and grows up to +120% stronger the more wounded Mark is.

name: Rude Buster
desc: A reckless axe shockwave that smashes all shields and hits harder the lower Susie's HP (up to +100%).

name: Mom's Fury
desc: Maternal rage: the more hurt Nicole is, the more it devastates (up to +110%), shattering guards.

name: Loyal Frenzy
desc: A manic, devoted assault: always crits, drains 25%, and rages stronger as Ren's HP drops.

name: Stretchy Bulwark
desc: Jake stretches into a colossal grapple that hits harder the healthier he is, then shields himself.

name: Donut Black Hole
desc: A dense donut that pulls in all foes, hitting harder the fuller (healthier) Homer is. Heals on hit.

name: Primal Stomp
desc: A prehistoric quake that scales with Gertie's current HP and builds heavy stagger on all foes.

name: Shinku Hadoken
desc: A focused ki blast that pierces guard, stuns, and burns brighter (up to +90%) as Ryu's spirit is pushed.

name: Luminaire
desc: The ultimate lightning tech: shocks and shatters guards, dealing +25% per debuff already on each foe.

name: God of Thunder
desc: Mjolnir's storm shatters shields and grows +25% stronger for every affliction already on a foe.

name: Slingshot Mayhem
desc: Chaotic pellets pelt random foes, mark them (-DEF), and hit +25% harder per debuff they carry.

name: Reality Glitch
desc: The animation breaks: glitches and lags all foes, then punishes the afflicted (+25% per debuff).

name: Clarinet of Doom
desc: A note so awful it slows AND weakens every foe, then deals bonus damage to the already-suffering.

name: Hairball Hazard
desc: A repulsive hairball that sickens and slows everyone, scaling with their accumulated misery.

name: Warsuit Annihilation
desc: Kryptonite warsuit beams that strip ALL enemy buffs, then obliterate the target through 50% DEF.
flavor: I am the future of humanity.

name: Just Monika
desc: She edits the enemy roster: deletes every foe's buffs and bypasses 70% of the target's DEF.

name: Cross-Examination
desc: Exposes a contradiction in every foe (-40% DEF for 4t) and rallies the squad's ATK. Cannot miss.

name: Turnabout Objection
desc: OBJECTION! Turns the tables: strips every enemy buff, marks them (-DEF), and rallies 20 Burst to allies.

name: Debate Club Knockout
desc: A sharp argument-turned-punch that breaks guard, stuns, and leaves the foe refuted (-35% DEF).
flavor: I have a few things to say.

name: Hollow Purple
desc: Infinity collides into an imaginary-mass blast: erases 80% of DEF, shatters shields, and cannot be dodged.

name: Aura Sphere Overload
desc: A perfectly-read aura sphere that never misses and always crits, no matter the foe's evasion.

name: Spy Strike Protocol
desc: An elite T.U.F.F. takedown: always crits, pierces 30% armor, and tags the target (-DEF).

name: Star Power Finale
desc: Invincible star energy crashes into every foe with an unavoidable, guaranteed critical hit.

name: Relentless Chase
desc: Corners the foe (slow), then lands a sure crit that deals +50% to anything slowed. Short cooldown.

name: Web-Slinger's Gambit
desc: Webs ensnare and slow all foes, then yank them for +40% damage against anything webbed.

name: Telepathic Foresight
desc: Reads every foe's move: marks them (-DEF), freezes some, and strikes frozen targets for +40%.

name: Spin Dash Barrage
desc: Spin-dashes scattered foes, charging their circuits; deals +60% to any already shorted out.
flavor: Two tails are better than one!

name: Clackers Overdrive
desc: No Stand yet -- this is young Joseph, Battle Tendency-era, all Hamon and Italian trickster charm. A feinted grin, a lie about the true target, then the clackers connect exactly where he said they wouldn't. He doesn't wear an enemy down himself -- he waits for them to already be reeling from burns, poisons, or a debuff-heavy squad, then reads the opening and ends it. Alone it's a decent hit; against a target the team has already worked over, it's brutal.
flavor: Your next line is... "I'll take that as a yes!"

name: Echoes Act 3: Freeze
desc: Echoes stamps crushing weight on the foe (heavy slow), then hits +60% against the slowed.

name: Sky Dragon's Roar
desc: A Sky Dragon's roar that buffets all foes and slows them, while cleansing and healing the caster.

name: Grass Sword Flurry
desc: Algebraic! A grass-blade whirl that poisons all foes and heals Finn for 20% of the damage dealt.

name: Piko Piko Hammer Smash
desc: A loving hammer-blow that shatters shields, staggers, stuns, and enrages Amy (+ATK) for the fight. Landing hammer swings now builds Momentum -- four in a row and her next skill is instantly ready.

name: Zero Point Rift
desc: Tears a rift through the field: ignores 30% DEF, slows, and leaves all foes Displaced (-DEF).

name: Slam Dunk Spike
desc: An athletic spike that stuns and crits for +50% against stunned foes. All net.

name: Anvil Drop Gag
desc: A cartoon anvil flattens the foe - massive stagger, a stun, and +25% per affliction they carry.

name: Counterspell Mastery
desc: CONTROL + VERSATILITY: silences every foe (no skills for 2 turns), dispels their buffs, and exposes their defenses -- then cleanses the squad's own debuffs and studies the field, sharpening everyone's crit chance and DEF. Whatever the fight needs, she's read the book on it.

name: Wingardium Leviosa
desc: A first-year levitates the foe helplessly (stun + -DEF) and shares her notes with the squad (+DEF). Short cooldown.
flavor: Now don't forget the swish and flick!

name: Niffler's Greed
desc: SUPPORT-THIEF: his niffler pilfers a buff from EVERY foe, his creatures heal the squad over time, and he drains a little life on contact.

name: Avada Kedavra
desc: THE KILLING CURSE: bypasses defense, evasion, AND shields, and instantly executes any foe below 50% HP (x3). Sows dread in survivors.
flavor: There is no good and evil, only power.

name: Abstract Splatter
desc: CHAOS PAINT: splatters every foe with a RANDOM curse, then hits +30% harder for each affliction already on the canvas.

name: Inhale & Copy
desc: COPY ABILITY: inhales the foe to COPY their buffs onto himself (they keep theirs), heals 30% of damage, and spits out a random elemental star.

name: Mach Tornado
desc: MULTI-HIT: a blinding sword cyclone strikes 4 times, each hit able to crit independently, and cannot be dodged.

name: Triple-Star Heist
desc: MASTER THIEF: snatches a buff from every foe, voids their remaining boons, plants a shock-trap, and vanishes faster (+SPD).
flavor: The Squeak Squad always gets the treasure.

name: Can't Let You Do That
desc: AMBUSH PREDATOR: a guaranteed critical that hits +70% harder against foes still near full HP. Strikes before they're ready.
flavor: Can't let you do that, Star Fox!

name: Viltrumite Judgment
desc: Pierces 50% of all armor, terrifies every foe (-ATK), and cleaves the wounded (below 40% HP). Overwhelming force.
flavor: Look what they make you give, son.

name: Matter Reconstruction
desc: REALITY CONTROL: cleanses and shields the squad with conjured matter, mends them over time, and UNMAKES every enemy's buffs.
flavor: I can make anything I want.

name: Harmonic Resonance
desc: ELEM +30%: a saxophone solo that harmonizes the squad's elemental damage (+30%), inverts each foe's buffs into debuffs, and rallies the team's Crit.
flavor: If anyone wants me, I'll be in my room.

name: Living Canvas
desc: PAINTER: brings living hazards to life on every foe (a random curse each) while conjuring protective art and healing for the squad.
flavor: Let me paint you a picture.

name: Carnage Scissors
desc: The Azure Grimoire devours the foe's vitality, tearing through armor and feeding on the kill.

name: Rabbit Beat
desc: A blur of Mitsumune-fueled jabs -- too fast to dodge, each landed hit chips deeper into a worn-down guard.
Just wants a snack! ...mostly harmless. Every third swipe, though, something ancient and starving wakes up behind her eyes.
flavor: Nyaha~! ...wait, what's happening to my claws?!

name: Ragnarok
desc: A keyblade flurry that ends in a beam of light -- punishes creatures of darkness and charges the whole party's resolve.

name: Way to the Dawn
desc: Channels the darkness without losing himself to it -- marks the foe's defenses and finishes the weak without mercy.
flavor: The closer you are to the darkness, the brighter you shine.

name: Tangled Web
desc: Her paper cup tail lashes out and snags the foe, lashing it to its own side -- for the next few turns, any damage dealt to its allies also yanks the tether, splashing onto the snared target too. Always finds its mark, always hits twice, and charges the whole squad's Burst.

name: Tyrant's Decree
desc: The Imperator's gohei fan parts the wind -- armor is brushed aside as if it were nothing, and the wound left behind makes everything that follows hurt more.

name: Bolverk's Judgment
desc: A lightning-charged blade strike that never misses its mark and always lands true -- the second swing follows before the foe can even guard.

name: Shooting Star
desc: The buster arm unloads a rapid volley -- extra rounds chamber automatically, and shadows make for easy targeting.
flavor: Time to dig up some treasure!

name: Chaos Delivery
desc: Rocko panics, flails, and somehow it works out -- the foe is afflicted with something unpredictable, and the sheer relief heals him a little.
flavor: Oh, this is bad, this is bad, this is bad--!

name: Heffer's Feast
desc: He eats absolutely everything in sight -- the hungrier he is, the harder this hits, and whatever he bites down on heals him right back up.

name: Inventor's Gambit
desc: A contraption of scavenged parts fires off, dispelling every buff the enemy side is hiding behind, while the whole squad gets fired up on Flik's latest invention and a surge of Burst.
flavor: It's not finished yet, but it'll work! Probably!

name: Tides of War
desc: Water answers her call -- a crashing wave that burns fire-touched foes worse than most, while the whole squad is wrapped in healing currents.
flavor: Water is the source of life, but I can make it the source of your defeat.

name: No Man's Land Protocol
desc: Months of contingency planning collapse onto one target -- defenses are marked and stripped, whatever buff they're hiding gets stolen, the strike cannot be dodged, and anything already on its last legs gets finished outright.
flavor: I've got a plan for you. I always do.

name: Yuletide Miracle
desc: A flurry of wrapped presents bursts open into pure holiday cheer -- the squad is cleansed of every debuff, wrapped in a gift-shaped shield, fired up with festive strength, and the whole team's Burst meter overflows.
flavor: Naughty or nice, everyone gets a gift from me!

name: Babysitter's Wrath
desc: Whatever's standing between her and a paycheck gets cracked open -- the stronger the barrier, the worse the payback -- and the follow-up swing can't be dodged.

name: Primal Smash
desc: Raw prehistoric strength -- barriers don't slow this down, the hit always lands true, and anything left reeling gets finished outright.

name: XJ-9 Override
desc: Combat protocols kick in -- the squad is patched up, wrapped in nanotech armor plating, and surges with Burst.

name: Silent Alliance
desc: She slips through the underbrush and signals her allies -- the whole squad finds cover behind a shield and starts mending wounds, no questions asked.
flavor: We can help each other. That's how we survive.

name: Tag and Roll
desc: A fresh coat of spray paint scrambles the enemy's buffs while the squad skates off with a shield and a burst of speed.

name: Dragoon's Descent
desc: Leaps skyward and crashes back down with a piercing lance strike, briefly emboldened by the fall. Now a real dive -- she crashes down on the WHOLE enemy line, not just one target, and her landing rallies the squad's aim.

name: Blade Heart: Finale
desc: Everything Tao's been reading off the fight so far -- every opening, every stagger, every debuff someone else already carved into the target -- gets dumped into one motion, blades moving faster than the eye tracks and landing exactly where they need to. It doesn't matter how well-armored or how fast the target thinks it is; her swords are already past that by the time it registers. If the hit kills, she's not even standing where she was anymore, gone before the body finishes falling, and everyone around her moves that much faster in the moment right after, riding the same speed she just proved was possible.
flavor: Every bullet, every blade -- make it count.

name: Crimson Nova: Spirit's Eruption
desc: Li plants her stance and calls up everything her spirit's been holding back -- not a single flame, a whole roaring pillar of it, punched straight through the target and out the other side. It doesn't matter what's standing there when it lands; between the heat and the pressure wave, armor doesn't hold the way it's supposed to, and anything already burning just gets fed. She comes out of the pose already glowing, ready to do it again, and for a few seconds everyone fighting beside her burns a little hotter too, catching sparks off her like she's the source now.

name: Game Over Screen
desc: Gaz paints a target lock on the enemy every cast, but she never plays the same round twice: round 1 just calls the shot, round 2 breaches their whole formation's defenses while sharpening the squad's aim, and round 3 is GAME OVER -- a full squad power spike plus a defense wipe on every enemy. Cycles in a fixed order, no luck involved.

name: Glyphic Mandate
desc: King invokes a forgotten titan's decree, sharpening the squad's instincts -- attacks against an elementally weak foe hit much harder for a few turns.
flavor: I am the king of all monsters... mostly.

name: Glacial Barrier
desc: Encases the whole squad in protective ice every cast -- nothing can touch them while it holds -- and the Ice King's mood escalates in a fixed pattern underneath: first he just chills the field, then he calls down a full Blizzard ward, then he reaches ABSOLUTE ZERO, mending the squad, hardening their defenses, and flash-freezing every foe solid. Same three moods, same order, every time.

name: YOU'RE FIRED!!!
desc: Benson finally loses it. Deals devastating bonus damage to any target the squad has already painted with a lock-on.

name: Solar Branding
desc: Blaze sears a brand into the enemy's hide -- for a few turns, the whole squad's attacks are drawn to the burning mark.

name: Leap of Faith
desc: Frog vaults clean out of harm's way and comes down blade-first. While airborne, nothing can touch him.

name: Shikigami Tactics
desc: Megumi always scouts the enemy's elemental weakness for the squad, but which shikigami answers the summons follows a fixed order: the Divine Dogs harass first, Nue swoops in next to hobble every foe's speed while sharpening the squad's aim, and on the third summon Mahoraga arrives and adapts, overwhelming the whole enemy line's defenses while charging the squad's elemental power. Same three summons, same order, every time -- no dice involved.

name: Rainbow Power Playtime!
desc: Puppycorn doesn't really have an attack pattern so much as a blur of bouncing, barking, sparkling chaos -- and somehow it hits way harder when the squad already has a target painted. The chaos doesn't stop when the hit lands, either: he's still wound up, and every basic swing after this one comes out just a little bit faster than the last.

name: Tiger Seven Forms: Finale
desc: The seventh and final form lands with crushing force -- devastating against a foe the squad has already marked.

name: Omnipresence: Whispers from the Void
desc: Reality bends as HIM closes in from every angle at once -- a target already marked has nowhere left to hide.
flavor: Ooooh, this is going to be FUN.

name: It's TV Time!
desc: Tenna puts the enemy live ON AIR -- the whole squad's attacks lock onto whoever's in the spotlight.

name: Shadow Clone Rasengan Barrage
desc: Naruto summons a wave of shadow clones to flank the target, then drives a spinning Rasengan home -- the clones poof away afterward, but not before drawing the heat off him.

name: Imagination Rainbow!
desc: SpongeBob unleashes pure, unfiltered imagination -- the whole squad is cleansed, shielded, and feeling like a million bucks (well, Krabby Patties).

name: Ballistic Chain Frenzy
desc: ELEM +50% (highest): Kazeto whirls her ball-and-chain into a foe, CRUSHING them — each hit adds a stack that shreds their DEF and makes her next blow hit even harder. Floods the squad with a massive +50% elemental damage and hypes herself into a frenzy (+ATK, +SPD).

name: Kanzeon: Full Analysis
desc: ELEM +40%: Himiko scans the whole battlefield, exposing every foe's weakness (-DEF) and feeding the squad targeting data — +40% elemental damage and +20% Crit. Cannot miss.

name: Turtle-School Kamehameha
desc: ELEM +30%: a channeled Kamehameha that blows through the target's shield and rocks them, while charging the squad's elemental damage (+30%) and Goku's own power (+ATK).

name: Uroboros Infestation
desc: ELEM +30% (complex): Wesker injects the Uroboros virus into all foes — stripping their buffs, ignoring 45% DEF, and draining 30% of the carnage as life. The mutation empowers the squad's elemental damage (+30%) and his own strength.

name: Capsule Corp Arsenal
desc: ELEM +35% (complex): Bulma deploys a barrage of gadgets — a Dragon Radar scan that marks every foe (-DEF) and dispels their buffs, while capsule tech shields the squad, floods 20 Burst, and overclocks their elemental damage (+35%). Never misses.

name: Onigiri Comfort Zone
desc: ELEM +30%: a lazy but loving cat-swipe that saps 25% of the damage as health, cleanses the squad, and wraps them in a cozy +30% elemental buff with lasting Regen. Slows the foes down to her pace.

name: Explosive Birdarang Volley
desc: ELEM +30%: a barrage of trick birdarangs that shatters the target's guard and stuns them, while the Boy Wonder's leadership sharpens the squad's elemental damage (+30%) and Crit.

name: Make a Contract
desc: ELEM +30% (eerie): Kyubey offers a wish that warps fate — a random curse strikes every foe, their protections are stripped away, and the squad is flooded with 30 Burst and a +30% elemental pact. There is always a price.
flavor: Make a contract with me, and become a magical girl!

name: Super Saiyan Overdrive
desc: ELEM +15% (lowest): a golden-aura haymaker built for one thing — annihilating a single target. Always crits, tears through shields, and executes foes below 40% HP for double. So focused on his own power that the squad only catches a small +15% elemental spark.
flavor: This is the power of a Super Saiyan!

name: I Wish For... EVERYTHING!
desc: REALITY-BENDING (cycles): Cosmo and Wanda grant a DIFFERENT wish every single cast, rotating through three modes. WISH 1 — Cosmo's Chaos: a random curse strikes every foe and the blast hits +70%. WISH 2 — Wanda's Wisdom: strips all enemy buffs, exposes them (-40% DEF) and sharpens the squad's Crit. WISH 3 — Fairy Teamwork: empowers the whole squad's elemental damage (+40%), shields, heals and floods 20 Burst. It's never the same wish twice.
flavor: I wish my fairies could grant ANY wish!

name: Final Heaven
desc: COMBO FINISHER: a flurry of martial strikes ending in a point-blank uppercut — always crits, lands two extra hits, and drains life with every blow.

name: Omnislash
desc: LIMIT BREAK: a blur of sword strikes that pierces 45% DEF, lands three extra hits, and finishes the wounded (below 35% HP) for double damage.

name: Gear Fourth: King Kong Gun
desc: BOUNCEMAN: pumps Haki into a titanic punch — hits harder the healthier Luffy is, shatters any guard, and builds heavy stagger.
flavor: I'm gonna be King of the Pirates!

name: Fire Dragon's Roar
desc: DRAGON SLAYER: a scorching breath that engulfs every foe in flame, deals +50% to anything already burning, and lets Natsu "eat" the heat back as HP.

name: Redemption's Blue Flame
desc: INNER FIRE: a blazing strike that burns brightest against darkness (+60% vs DARK-type foes) while cleansing the squad's doubts (removes all debuffs).
flavor: It is time for me to look inward and begin asking the big questions: Who am I, and what do I want?

name: Tsukuyomi: Amaterasu
desc: GENJUTSU AMBUSH: traps the target in an inescapable illusion (cannot miss, always crits) then sears them with unquenchable black flame.

name: Lucky 38 Override
desc: Under the hood this is just a gun shot -- until the SPECIAL build kicks in. Every point of AGILITY adds another bullet to the volley AND wraps him in HASTE, so a fast Courier unloads a storm of hits and cycles his abilities far quicker than anyone else. Whichever stat is HIGHEST reshapes the move AND brands the target/himself with a rising status that snowballs each turn: STR stokes OVERHEAT (climbing power), PER sharpens PRECISION (climbing crit), END builds FORTIFY (climbing defense), CHA radiates CHARM (climbing luck), INT spins up OVERCLOCK (climbing magic). Invest in two stats and the build blends into something new -- STR+AGI is a blitzing gunslinger who never stops moving. Every OTHER stat still isn't wasted, either -- any point above baseline ticks a smaller undertone of that same effect on top of the headline archetype, so a secondary investment in, say, END or INT always does SOMETHING even when it isn't the stat running the show. Max every SPECIAL stat and the chip stops holding back at all. Put no points anywhere and it's exactly what it looks like: a guy with a revolver.
flavor: Six bullets, more than enough to kill anything that moves.

name: X Marks the Spot
desc: TREASURE HUNTER'S EYE: never misses -- she's cased this joint already. Rips a buff right out of the target's pocket and marks them for the whole crew to follow up on (-25% DEF, 3 turns). Catch someone still at full health and it's an ambush bonus -- untouched vaults get cracked hardest. Quick hands mean this always lands twice, and she picks the next guy's pocket for their turn before they even get to move.

name: 1.21 Gigawatts
desc: TEMPORAL RECALIBRATION: three fixed jumps, same order every time. 1955 just gets the DeLorean up to speed. 1985 rips a hole in their defenses and juices the whole squad's offense. 2015 is the real payoff -- a full-power strike that reaches back and restores whichever ally is worst off to their actual HP from a few turns back, floods Burst, and hands out a squad-wide crit buff. Not a heal -- an honest-to-god rewind.
flavor: Roads? Where we're going, we don't need roads.

name: Nobody Calls Me Chicken
desc: CONFIDENCE SURGE: three fixed beats, same order every time. First the hoverboard kicks in, then he starts talking like his old man never taught him different, then he borrows a page out of Doc's book -- a quick hop back to how he was feeling a second ago. Each stage psyches Marty up a little more for the next one.

name: 4*Town Forever
desc: She shifts -- claws out, fur up, fully in control. In this form she is almost impossible to land a hit on, and the people beside her fight harder knowing she has their back: they take less, heal steadily, and hit a little meaner. She won't out-damage you. She'll simply outlast you -- and only a strike that genuinely can't miss ever seems to find her.

name: Emerald Splash
desc: Hierophant Green scatters a spray of emeralds that curve mid-air and chase the target down -- there's nowhere to lean that they don't follow. Slows whatever they catch.

name: That Will Do
desc: The whip cracks before you've finished moving. It does not miss; it has never missed. Whoever it lands on comes away shaken and hitting softer, and her own side stands a little straighter.

name: Plasma Lock
desc: The paralyzer paints a lock first, then fires. Once it's tagged you, footwork doesn't matter -- the shot corrects to wherever you went. Leaves the mark reeling.

name: Caring Heart
desc: The leader of the bears throws the whole team behind a wall of pure care. Everyone gets a second chance at life this fight, and a protective ward that grows stronger the longer the fight drags on -- then he lands a huge, heartfelt hit.

name: Rainbow Resonance
desc: Cheer Bear's power isn't her own -- it's every Care Bear she's ever cheered on. The more bears standing with her (and the higher they've grown), the harder her rainbow hits, and for a moment she resonates with the strongest one and borrows their shine. Grows as your bears grow.
flavor: Cheer up! We're in this together!

name: Share the Care
desc: A rapid triple burst of caring energy sprayed across the whole enemy line, with a little pick-me-up shared to the team on the way out.

name: Roll of the Dice
desc: Good Luck Bear leaves the outcome to fate -- and the luckier he is, the better fate treats him. Could be a jackpot crit, a lucky heal for the team, a curse on the enemy, or just a solid hit. You never quite know.

name: Sunbeam
desc: A blazing beam of sunshine that scorches every foe with lingering sunburn -- and every ray that lands warms the whole team back to health.

name: Nap Time
desc: Bedtime Bear tucks the enemy in whether they like it or not. Sleeping foes skip their turns entirely -- until a hard hit jolts them awake. Best paired with allies patient enough not to swing early.

name: Sweet Dreams
desc: A gentle wave of comfort that mends the whole team, cleanses their worries, and wraps them in a soft protective shield.

name: Mind Enslavement
desc: A psychic tendril burrows into one mind at once, warping their will -- their attacks weaken and their thoughts slow to a crawl. When Elder Brain's presence is felt nearby, the enslavement spreads to the whole squad at once.

name: Psychic Dominion
desc: A wave of raw psychic force crashes across every mind in range, leaving them rattled and exposed. Standing near Aboleth turns the wave into a full hive-mind assault.
flavor: We are legion. You are nothing.

name: Voidgrasp
desc: Spectral tendrils drag one victim into a lightless pocket dimension -- the pull cannot be dodged, and whatever it grabs feeds the Balhannoth's own strength. Flumph's light bends the void into something far worse.
flavor: There is no escaping the dark.

name: Gentle Drift
desc: An oddly calming psychic hum that quietly bolsters everything nearby -- gentle, but never to be underestimated. Near Balhannoth, that same calm curdles into something unsettling.

name: Pack Leader's Fury
desc: Two savage strikes in one lunge, and every hit stokes his rage further -- the longer the fight runs, the harder he bites. Fighting alongside Bangaa Pirate turns the pair into a coordinated hunting blitz.

name: Reckless Boarding
desc: A wild, all-or-nothing cutlass rush that punishes anything already wounded. Pairs viciously with Alpha Wolf's pack tactics.

name: Overload Plating
desc: Cobbled-together armor plates lock down hard, growing more impenetrable with every passing turn. Standing beside Gargantua channels that stored energy into a devastating discharge.

name: Titanfall
desc: A colossal, ground-shaking slam that hits like the end of the world. When Brainpan is close enough to redirect the shockwave, Titanfall stops being a single hit at all.

name: Fleeting Predation
desc: Three lightning-quick slashes from a hunter that's already gone before the pain registers. Hunting alongside the Demogorgon opens a rift the whole squad has to answer to.
flavor: You never see it coming twice.

name: Upside Down
desc: Reality peels back and something ancient reaches through -- the strike finds prey no matter how far they've run, and finishes the badly wounded outright. When Feyr is hunting alongside it, the rift swallows everyone.

name: Ripple Overdrive
desc: Jonathan never got a Stand -- Hamon is all will and repetition, so the more this squad has actually been swinging, the harder this lands. No flashy summon, no shortcut: just a gentleman who doesn't stop hitting things, hitting harder the longer the fight runs.
flavor: I, Jonathan Joestar, will not lose!

name: The World: Toki wo Tomare
desc: Time stops. Everyone but Dio -- frozen mid-motion, unable to act, unable to even see it coming. He gets his shots in while the world holds still, then it starts moving again like nothing happened. WRYYYYY.

name: Solar Surfer
desc: Jim rides in on his solar surfboard and sends Morph flying to whichever ally needs him most (the lowest-HP teammate) -- the little shapeshifter scrubs every debuff off them and pumps up their damage, basics and skills alike, so they're free to keep fighting at full strength. At the same time Jim inspires the whole crew and charges everyone up ENERGIZED off his surfer's solar cells: energized allies bank extra Burst every time they land a basic attack, and Jim tops off the squad's Burst meter the instant he lands.
flavor: Just leave it to us, Morph!

name: Cybernetic Cannon
desc: Silver's arm reconfigures into a massive cannon and unloads a devastating blast across every enemy on the field, sending them reeling (a Speed-sapping knockback). The lower his own HP, the harder the cannon hits and the more it shreds their footing -- a cornered cyborg is the most dangerous one. Firing a cannon that big isn't free, though: the recoil costs Silver a chunk of his own health, and the same shot triggers a quick self-repair -- his cybernetics patch him back up, and he moves and swings noticeably faster while they're humming.
flavor: Cabin boy, I am your friend till the end. But I am NOT a fool.

name: To Arms!
desc: Captain Amelia commands the whole crew into action, whipping every ally's abilities back into readiness -- a squad-wide HASTE that gets skills back off cooldown fast. If the fighting turns against her, discipline takes over: she falls back to the rear of the formation, her attack speed spiking as she keeps firing from a safer range, exactly as a good captain corrects course under fire.
flavor: I've a ship full of cutthroats and only two hands.

name: Celestial Calculations
desc: Not a fighter, but never a liability -- Doppler charts the whole engagement like the astronomer he is, plotting exact trajectories through the chaos. He marks every enemy's weak point (a squad-wide EXPOSE that shreds their defense) and hands his whole crew TRUESIGHT, so precisely-calculated strikes stop missing entirely for a few turns. Ever the devoted family friend, he doesn't forget to look after the people he dragged along on this voyage: the ally who needs it most gets mended and a protective ward, because financing the expedition doesn't mean he stopped worrying about the crew.
flavor: Splendid vessel you've procured, Miss Hawkins!

name: Fancy Footwork
desc: A TRUE support turn, not a nuke: Marie sticks her tongue out and dashes through the whole enemy line, dodging in close so THEY come after HER -- stripping their Armor and Reality, Silencing them, and marking every one of them an easy target for the rest of the squad. She settles in with a bowl of milk, gaining Momentum and a rising Armor/Reality buff the longer she tanks the heat, while the team gets scrubbed of their worst debuff and a touch of her own poise. She's not here to finish the fight -- she's here to make sure nobody else has to.

name: Reflexive Ward
desc: CUT-IN: casts a protective ward and marks a foe weak (-18% DEF, 3t). For the rest of the fight, Harry reflexively disarms enemies with a defense-shredding counter-charm whenever they cast an ability.

name: Satsui no Hado
desc: CUT-IN: channels the Dark Hado, surging his own ATK (+30%, 4t). For the rest of the fight, every time an ally lands a basic attack, Akuma cuts in with a follow-up demon strike on a random foe.

name: Harmony Cascade
desc: CUT-IN: attunes to the squad's magic, shielding the team (25% max HP, 3t). For the rest of the fight, every time ANY ally (including herself) gains a buff, Twilight echoes it with a burst of harmonic energy, sharpening her own crit chance.

name: Full System Restore
desc: SUPPORT: a complete maintenance cycle for the whole squad -- cleanses every debuff, mends a huge chunk of HP, wraps everyone in lasting Regen, and leaves a defensive plating shield behind. The one call every team needs when things are falling apart.
flavor: Everyone, hold still -- this'll only take a second!

name: Copy System: Variable Weapons
desc: COPY BOT: every shot scans a random foe and copies a weapon matching their element on the spot -- Fire Storm, Ice Slasher, Gale Slicer, Solar Blaze, Shadow Blade, or Stone Crusher, each with its own animation, damage type, and rider effect. No SPECIAL stats, no build to invest in -- purely emergent from who he's fighting. Copy the SAME element again later in the fight and the weapon comes back MASTERED, hitting progressively harder each repeat (+12%/repeat, capped +60%) -- the more he uses a weapon, the better he gets with it. Whatever he hasn't copied yet defaults to a plain Mega Buster shot.
flavor: Mega Buster, ready! ...wait, what's THIS do?

name: Runway Rumble
desc: Honey drops into a flawless three-hit combo -- jab, spinning heel-kick, finishing claw rake -- and turns it into a full critique: the target's stance gets torn apart (SLOWED, GUARD DOWN) while Honey herself struts into rhythm. Land it while an ally's already got someone exposed and she puts extra heat into the finisher. Landing basic swipes while she's in rhythm builds toward an instant reset -- she never really leaves the stage.
flavor: Darling, that outfit is a CRIME -- let me fix it.

name: Absolute Zero Command
desc: Blossom drops the temperature to nothing with a point-blank ice beam, then goes full squad leader: TEAM SPIRIT lights up every ally's attack, her own tactical read sharpens her crits, and the whole team's cooldowns get a shot of momentum. Land it on a target someone already rattled and the beam bites twice as hard.
flavor: I'm not bossy. I'm the leader.

name: Sonic Meltdown
desc: Sweet as sugar right up until she isn't -- Bubbles cuts loose with a scream that rattles the whole enemy line, and while everyone's ears are ringing she's already turned around to scrub her sisters clean and wrap them in a bubble of protection. Don't push her.

name: Sucker Punch
desc: No plan, no setup, no crowd control -- Buttercup just hits it as hard as she possibly can. Simple, blunt, and it works. If someone else already rattled the target, it works even better.

name: Evil Genius Monologue
desc: Mojo Jojo activates his latest doomsday contraption while delivering an extremely long, extremely repetitive explanation of his own villainy -- by the time he's done clarifying what he just said in the sentence before, the whole enemy line has tuned out and half of them have forgotten why they were even fighting.
flavor: Which is another way of saying: I have said what I have said!

name: Widdle Bit o' Fear
desc: The voice changes mid-sentence, the temperature drops, and something with lobster claws and a tutu leans in far too close. HIM doesn't need to hit hard -- the whole enemy line freezes up from pure dread, and whatever confidence they were feeling a second ago is HIM's now.
flavor: Oh, we're going to have SO much fun together.

name: Securitron Legion
desc: House barely moves -- he doesn't need to. A full legion of Securitrons rolls out on his command, raking the enemy line with suppressive fire while an automated escort locks in around his own squad: shields up, armor reinforced, systems running at peak efficiency. Two centuries of planning don't leave much to chance.
flavor: I've had two hundred years to plan for this moment.

name: Cheyenne, Sic 'Em!
desc: Sunny lines up a clean rifle shot while Cheyenne darts in low for a distracting nip at the ankles -- textbook Goodsprings teamwork. She's not the flashiest gun in the room, but she'll happily walk anyone through exactly how she did it.
flavor: Just take your time and squeeze the trigger, don't jerk it.

name: Whiskey Rose
desc: Cass takes a pull straight from the bottle, levels her shotgun, and unloads -- both barrels, no hesitation. It hits like a freight train. The hangover's a problem for later.
flavor: Bottoms up. Let's see what you got.

name: One Shot, One Kill
desc: First Recon doesn't miss. Boone finds the one angle that matters, marks it, and puts a single round through it -- no evasion in the world helps once he's decided you're the target. Anything already on its last legs just stops existing.
flavor: I killed a lot of people. Didn't have a good reason not to, after a while.

name: Also This: A Warning
desc: Ulysses doesn't raise his voice. He just explains, calmly and at length, exactly what the flag someone's carrying actually means -- and by the time he's done, whatever confidence they walked in with has curdled into doubt. Their own strength turns against them.
flavor: You don't know what you did. Not really.

name: Rage Mode: Awesome Party!
desc: One second she's radiating pure sparkly positivity, the next her eyes are glowing red and there is fire everywhere -- Unikitty's Rage Mode hits harder the more banged-up she already is, but somehow the squad still comes out of it feeling AMAZING, buffed up and moving faster than before. She'll apologize for the flames later. Probably.
flavor: THIS IS THE AWESOMEST PARTY IN THE UNIVERSE!!!

name: Comprehensive Coverage
desc: Richard steps in front, cites the relevant liability clause, and takes full responsibility for whatever happens next -- which mostly means absorbing it personally so nobody else has to. Everyone else is free to move without worrying about the paperwork.
flavor: I've got you covered. It's in the policy.

name: Eureka Engine Overdrive
desc: Dr. Fox has, in the space of about four seconds, sketched a schematic, welded it together out of spare parts, patched it into the squad's own bioenergy signatures, and started narrating the whole process out loud to nobody in particular -- something about capacitance and 'obviously' and 'why didn't I think of this sooner.' The device works. It always works. Every ally's abilities come online dramatically faster, a chunk of everyone's cooldown gets refunded on the spot, the whole squad's Burst meter tops off, and Dr. Fox herself is left standing in the afterglow, visibly buzzing with her own genius, sharper and more dangerous for the next few turns than anyone gave her credit for. Somewhere in the chaos, whatever she was supposedly building for the ENEMY side just short-circuits instead.
flavor: Obviously. OBVIOUSLY. Why didn't I think of this SOONER?!

name: Lifeup & Shield Ω
desc: Ness doesn't say much about it -- he never really has -- but somewhere between the homesickness and the sleepless nights on the road, he learned to take care of people before he learned to fight for them. He closes his eyes, thinks about everyone standing next to him, and just like that the whole squad's wounds close up and something goes taut and watchful around them, like nothing that lands next is allowed to be the last thing that happens.

name: Bottle Rocket Barrage
desc: Jeff dumps half his inventory onto the ground, does some quick mental math nobody asked for, and starts lighting fuses. Most of what he built out of spare parts and dumb luck works about as well as you'd expect from a kid who reads too many science magazines -- which is to say, unpredictably, but when one connects it usually connects for everybody in the blast radius.

name: PK Starstorm Ω
desc: Paula doesn't flinch, doesn't hesitate, doesn't leave an opening -- she just looks up, and the sky answers her. There is no ducking this, no blocking it, no clever defensive trick that gets you out from under it; it was never that kind of attack. By the time anyone else finishes winding up whatever they were planning, it's already over.
flavor: You don't get to dodge this one.

name: The Suporma
desc: After weeks -- okay, maybe years -- of funded research, Orange Kid finally wheels it out: the Super Orange Machine. It hums, it glows, it plays a genuinely lovely little tune called 'Ode to Orange Kid'... and then it breaks, exactly like it always does. But for one glorious second before it dies, it puts out enough stray energy to juice the whole squad. He'll get right back to work unboiling eggs.
flavor: Ha ha ha... it, uh... it's SUPPOSED to do that.

name: Snowgrave
desc: CUT-IN: Noelle goes quiet, and the temperature in the room actually drops -- a small, cold spell that leaves the target reeling and half-frozen where they stand. For the rest of the fight, every time an enemy commits to casting something, she's already answering back, a splinter of ice landing before they've even finished the animation. She never raises her voice. She doesn't have to.

name: Bad Little Boy
desc: CUT-IN: Marceline floats up over the whole squad, kicks off a bassline only a thousand-year-old vampire queen could actually play, and the sheer weight of it warps the air -- everyone's next few hits carry a little extra bite, her own fangs included, and whatever she takes off the enemy she keeps for herself. She shakes off anything that was slowing her down before the first chord even finishes ringing. For the rest of the fight, the instant any ally lands a basic attack, she's already there beside them, uninvited, taking a bite of her own -- a thousand years of bad habits paying out as a burst of stolen vitality, over and over, for as long as the fight keeps going.

name: Strafing Run
desc: CUT-IN: Miyu banks in low and rakes the whole enemy line with cannon fire, the kind of pass that only works because she's already lined up the shot before anyone noticed she moved. For the rest of the fight, the second any ally opens up with an ability, she's peeling off to cover them -- a follow-up strafing pass that leaves whoever's left standing a little easier to finish off.
flavor: Copy that -- coming around for another pass.

name: No Fate
desc: Sarah doesn't hesitate, doesn't flinch, doesn't waste a single motion -- years of running, training, and preparing for a war nobody else believes is coming have burned every ounce of doubt out of her. She puts the shot exactly where it needs to go, and in the same breath she's already barking orders, hardening the whole squad's stance and getting everyone moving before the echo fades. There's no fate but what you make, and right now she's making sure the squad survives long enough to make it.
flavor: The future's not set. There's no fate but what we make for ourselves.

team_effects.label: NO FATE BUT WHAT WE MAKE

name: I'll Be Back
desc: The T-800 plants itself between the squad and whatever's coming, servos locking, endoskeleton plating shifting to take the brunt of it. It doesn't negotiate, doesn't retreat, doesn't feel the damage the way a person would -- it just keeps standing there, absorbing hits that would drop anyone else, patching itself up in the gaps between blows. Nothing about the way it holds the line changes for the rest of the fight. It said it would be back, and it is, every single time.

name: Come With Me If You Want to Live
desc: Kyle doesn't wait to be asked -- he's already moving, putting himself between the squad's most exposed ally and whatever's bearing down on them, laying down cover fire the entire way. He's spent his whole life protecting one specific future, and it shows in how automatic this is: shield up, weapon up, squad moving, all in the same breath. Whoever needed it most just got a little harder to kill, and Kyle's not slowing down until this fight is over.
flavor: Come with me if you want to live.

name: Clinical Assessment
desc: Dr. Silberman doesn't throw a punch in his life, but he's spent his career reading people, and it turns out that skill translates disturbingly well to reading whatever's trying to kill you -- a pause here, a tell there, and suddenly he knows exactly where it's weak. He talks the squad down in the same even, professional tone the whole time, steadying nerves that were starting to fray. He was right about Sarah Connor being the sanest person in that hospital. He's right about this, too.
flavor: I'd say you're a very lucky man, Mrs. Connor. In my professional opinion.

name: Perfect Heist
desc: Rouge doesn't rush a job -- she cases it, waits for the exact right second, and then the whole world just... stops giving her trouble. For a couple of heartbeats nothing on the enemy side is able to so much as flinch while she works, gliding through the opening she planned for and taking exactly what she came for on the way past. She's gone again before time catches back up, already checking her nails like nothing happened, and for a moment after, the whole squad moves like they've got the same head start she does.
flavor: A girl's gotta have her jewels.

name: Chaos Control
desc: Shadow grips the emerald and tears a hole straight through the moment -- everything on the enemy side lurches, freezes, loses its footing in time for just a beat before the world lands back where it's supposed to be. It's the same trick he's used to dodge missiles and outrun collapsing space stations, scaled down to a fight instead of a catastrophe, and it still works, mostly. He comes out of it a little charged up, ready to swing again -- it just doesn't hold the room the way the real thing is supposed to.

name: Brain Blast: Catastrophic Failure
desc: Jimmy doesn't really believe this one's going to work either, but he runs the numbers out loud anyway -- fast, clipped, more bitter than excited -- and something on his belt actually sparks to life for once. It never lasts. He also draws every hostile eye in the arena the instant the fight starts, whether or not this ability is even equipped, purely because everyone in earshot already knows exactly how this ends and would rather get it over with. Sooner or later -- usually sooner -- one of his own inventions goes off wrong, and it's the last thing he ever gets to be right about: even in failure, some part of him still made sure the squad walked away stronger for it.

team_effects.label: RUN, HE'S GOING TO GET US KILLED

name: Encore
desc: Blot bows, mimes pulling an invisible rope, and shouts something that's clearly meant to be encouraging -- except it comes out backwards, every time, the way everything out of Blot comes out backwards, so what the squad actually hears is a garbled little burst of noise running in reverse. Nobody's ever quite sure what he said. He seems to mean it, though, and for a couple of seconds it's enough.

name: Ice-Make: Death Scythe
desc: Gray claps his hands together -- fist into open palm, the same stance every time, the one Ur beat into him until it was instinct instead of memory -- and a field of jagged ice blades erupts across the entire enemy line, freezing anything they don't outright shred. He doesn't say much while he works; Ur never let him get away with sloppy technique, and he's not about to start now. The cold rolls off him afterward, thickening the squad's own defenses like frost creeping over armor.

name: Photographic Precision
desc: Barbara's already cross-referenced the target's whole profile before the fight even started -- she's got the file memorized, every weakness flagged, every pattern logged from three separate stakeouts. She puts one precise strike exactly where the notes say it'll hurt most, and the read doesn't stop there: for a few seconds the whole squad is fighting off her intel, hitting cleaner because she already mapped out where to aim.
flavor: I already know how this ends for you.

name: A Stately Intervention
desc: Alfred doesn't raise his voice. He never has to -- he simply arrives, exactly when needed, first-aid kit already open, and starts working on whoever's worse for wear while delivering a short, dry observation about their life choices. Wounds close, nerves settle, and the whole squad straightens up a little, because apparently even mid-battle it's simply not done to look shabby in front of Master Wayne's butler.
flavor: Do try not to bleed on the carpet, sir.

name: Signal in the Sky
desc: Gordon doesn't have powers, doesn't have gadgets, doesn't even particularly like how any of this works -- but he knows exactly who to call, and he lights the signal without a second's hesitation. The whole squad rallies off the sight of it, and the worst offender on the field gets a searchlight nailed to its back, impossible to lose track of for the rest of the fight.

name: Last Laugh
desc: There's no telling what's coming out of the sleeve this time -- acid flower, joy buzzer, something with a fuse -- and that's rather the point. The Joker doesn't plan so much as improvise catastrophically, hitting the whole enemy line with whatever gag happens to be loaded, leaving each of them stuck with a different, entirely unpredictable little curse. He walks away cackling regardless of how it actually landed. It always lands funny to him.

name: Hammer Time!
desc: Harley winds up her big comedy mallet like it's the funniest thing in the world, and then it comes down with a lot more physics behind it than the giant foam-looking head has any right to carry. Every debuff already stacked on the target makes the swing land that much harder, and if it actually connects clean, she's already cartwheeling off, delighted with herself, laughing the whole way.

name: Call It
desc: Harvey flips the coin -- the scarred side always lands the same way it lands in his head, and everyone around him has learned to just wait and see which Harvey shows up on the other side of the toss. Sometimes it's the DA who still believes in the process, methodical and precise. Sometimes it's the other one. Either way, somebody's about to have a very bad night, and Harvey's already decided it isn't going to be him.

name: Gentleman's Umbrella Barrage
desc: Oswald pops the catch on his umbrella and it's suddenly not an umbrella at all -- barrels swinging up out of the ribs, unloading a volley that somehow still manages to look dapper doing it. He waddles back a step, straightens his monocle, and lets the rest of his hired muscle pick up the slack, rallied by nothing more than the sheer confidence of watching the boss actually deliver for once.

name: Riddle Me This
desc: Nygma poses the question before the target's even braced for it, and there's no good answer -- get it wrong and it costs you, get it right and it still costs you, because the game was rigged from the first syllable. He can't help narrating his own genius while he does it, which would almost be a weakness if he weren't always, infuriatingly, exactly right.

name: For Nora
desc: Everything Victor does now, he does with the same flat, mechanical calm -- the suit hisses, the cold gun levels, and a wave of subzero air rolls out across whatever's in front of him. It isn't rage. It's just math, the same equation he's been running since Gotham took her from him, and the squad gets pulled into its own share of the shielding that keeps his own systems running. He'll apologize to no one for what he's willing to do to fix it.
flavor: I will not rest until I find a cure.

name: Nature's Wrath
desc: Ivy doesn't raise her voice either -- the vines do the talking, bursting up through whatever's underfoot and dosing the target with a toxin she's had years to perfect. The same breath she used to poison them also carries something sweeter to her own side, a pheromone-laced calm that knits the squad back together while the enemy's own strength wilts under her control.
flavor: Nature always wins in the end.

name: Nine Lives
desc: Selina doesn't so much attack as relieve someone of something -- a whip-crack, a graceful dodge back out of range, and whatever edge the target thought they had is suddenly hers instead. She lands the way cats always land, already recalculating her next move, unbothered by the fact that she was never really supposed to be here in the first place.
flavor: I always land on my feet.

name: Fear Itself
desc: Crane doesn't need to touch anyone -- the gas does the work, a fine mist that finds whatever each target's actually afraid of and makes them live it for a few seconds. Some freeze outright. Some just can't bring themselves to swing as hard as they know they should. He watches it happen with the calm, clinical interest of a man who considers this all very good research.

name: Lazarus Resolve
desc: Ra's has died before. Several times, in fact, and come back sharper each time -- so he doesn't fight like someone worried about losing. He steps back, lets the pit's old trick run through the whole squad instead of just himself, hardening them with centuries of patience and the quiet certainty that whatever happens tonight, the League endures regardless.
flavor: Death is nothing to fear, detective. I would know.

name: Shapeless Threat
desc: Basil doesn't have a fixed shape to hit anymore -- an arm becomes a hammer, the hammer becomes a wave, and whatever the target was relying on to hurt him is suddenly running through his own body like it belongs there. He reforms mid-hit, taking on a piece of whatever advantage the enemy just showed him, patient in the specific way only something that can't permanently die has any right to be.
flavor: I am whatever I need to be.

name: Venom Surge
desc: The tubes at Bane's temple pump once, hard, and everything about him gets bigger and meaner in the same breath -- the same trick that put Batman in traction, running through him again with the same clinical excess he's always used it with. He doesn't waste the surge on anything but the strongest thing in front of him. Breaking the biggest obstacle first has always been the whole point.
flavor: I broke the Bat. I can break you.

name: Down the Rabbit Hole
desc: Jervis tips his hat, the mind-control chips inside it humming, and suddenly the whole fight feels a little less real, a little more like a story someone's telling badly. He can't ever quite tell reality from the version of it he's built in his head anymore, and for a few seconds neither can whoever he's just fixed his attention on.

name: Sonic Shriek
desc: Whatever's left of Kirk Langstrom loses out to the serum every time this happens -- the jaw distends, the wings unfold, and a shriek comes out that isn't really a voice anymore, pitched to rattle everything in earshot. He doesn't fully remember it afterward. He never does. That's rather the tragedy of it.

name: Apex Predator
desc: Waylon doesn't bother with technique -- he doesn't need it. He just goes for whoever's already hurting, jaws first, the same way anything else at the bottom of the sewers learns to pick off the weakest thing in the water. What doesn't kill him barely slows him down; his own hide's thick enough that most of what comes back at him afterward doesn't matter much either.
